plans.title: Study plans of group {{group}}
plans.subtitle: Review the plans students have sent and approve them or return them with a comment.
plans.approveReadyDescription: Only plans awaiting approval with no errors will be approved. Students get a notification; further changes are possible only during add/drop.

review.returnedWith: Plan returned to the student with a comment
review.commentRequired: Write a comment — the student will see it in their study plan

waive.hint: The student will be able to take the course without the prerequisite. The comment goes into the plan history.

approve.title: Approve {{name}}'s study plan?
approve.description: Once approved, the student can change the plan only during add/drop.
approve.blocked: You can approve once the plan has no errors: waive the prerequisite or return the plan for changes.

return.title: Return the study plan for changes
return.description: The plan becomes a draft again; the student sees your comment and can fix their choice.
return.commentHint: Be specific: which course to replace or what to add.
return.done: Study plan returned to the student

offerings.title: Department sections
offerings.hint: Groups below the minimum are closed for low demand (R-09): students are moved to another teacher of the same course.

close.noReassign: Do not move — students choose again
close.title: Close the group for low demand?
close.description: Enrolled students ({{count}}) will be moved to: {{target}}. They will be notified; seats in this group cannot be restored.

panel.title: Semester timetable
panel.noVersion: There is no timetable version yet.
panel.hardHint: Publishing is blocked while there are violations
panel.softHint: Gaps, transfers, balance: the closer to zero, the better

solver.title: Solver
solver.hint: Builds a draft automatically. Pinned classes stay put; the rest are placed with no hard violations and the lowest penalty.
solver.stopped: Solver stopped; the best solution found was kept

result.STOPPED: Solver stopped — the best solution found was kept

solver.locked: The version is under review or approved — the solver runs on drafts only.

actions.title: Review and publishing
actions.blocked: Fix the hard violations first: {{count}}. They are listed under “Conflicts”.

submit-review.title: Send the draft to departments?
submit-review.description: Departments will see their teachers' timetables and leave comments. The draft cannot be edited during review.
submit-review.done: Draft sent to departments for review

approve.title: Approve this timetable version?
approve.description: Once approved, the version can be published. Changes require a new version.

publish.title: Publish the timetable?
publish.description: Students and teachers will see the timetable and be notified about their classes. Further changes go through substitutions and rescheduling.

waiting.DRAFT: The timetable scheduler is preparing the draft.
waiting.REVIEW: The version is under review. The registrar's office approves it.
waiting.APPROVED: The version is approved. The registrar's office publishes it.
waiting.PUBLISHED: The version is published. Changes go through substitutions and rescheduling.

actions.reviewsPending: You can approve once all departments have reviewed it: {{approved}} of {{total}} so far.

grid.title: Timetable grid
grid.caption: Class grid: {{entity}}
grid.selectHint: Select a class in the grid to see its conflicts and find a free slot and room. With a mouse you can drag a class to another cell.

readOnly.title: The grid is read-only
readOnly.locked: The version is not a draft, or the solver is running.
readOnly.noRight: The timetable scheduler edits the grid.

lesson.noSlots: No free slots: the teacher or groups are busy at every time.
lesson.pinned: Class pinned — the solver will not move it
lesson.pinnedHint: A pinned class cannot be moved. Unpin it to move it.

conflict.H-02: Group {{group}}: two classes at once — {{day}}, period {{slot}}
conflict.H-07: The class is not placed in the grid
conflict.S-01: Group {{group}}: gaps in the timetable — {{day}}, periods: {{count}}
conflict.S-08: Group {{group}}: two classes of the same course on one day — {{day}}

conflicts.title: Timetable conflicts
conflicts.subtitle: Hard violations block publishing; soft ones are penalties the solver tries to reduce.

task.title: Timetable task
task.none: The registrar's office has not sent streams and groups yet.
task.received: Received from the registrar's office on {{date}}
task.demoNote: In the demo the grid below uses a separate data set: a timetable without overlaps cannot be built from the sample groups.

none.title: No teacher assigned
none.description: Students see the course in the catalogue but cannot choose it.

form.minHint: If fewer students enrol, the group is closed for low demand (R-09).
form.minError: The minimum must be a whole number from 1
form.maxError: Seats must be a whole number not below the minimum and not above 300
form.takenError: {{taken}} students are already enrolled — seats cannot be fewer
form.created: Section assigned — students already see it when choosing a teacher

workload.title: Teaching load
workload.subtitle: Planned classroom hours for the semester from the department's sections, compared with the norm.
workload.allOk: All teachers are within the norm
workload.spoken: Planned load {{total}} hours against a norm of {{norm}}

changes.title: Substitution requests
changes.subtitle: An approved substitution or reschedule appears in students' timetables and on the displays right away.
changes.cancelDescription: Students in the group will be notified and the class will be marked as cancelled in the timetable.
changes.rejectHint: The teacher will see it in their requests.

review.title: Timetable review

notInReview.title: The version is not under review right now

review.approveDescription: The registrar's office can approve it once all departments have.
review.remarksHint: Be specific: which class, what is wrong and what would be better.

sent.title: Task sent to the scheduler on {{date}}
sent.description: If you change a group or its teacher, the task has to be sent again.

skipped.title: Not re-formed because of manual edits: {{count}}
skipped.description: These sections kept their manual changes. You can re-form a specific section from its card.

build.title: Splitting parameters
build.hint: Students are sorted by academic group, so groups stay together where possible (§4.6).
build.rebuildDescription: Sections edited by hand stay as they are. The rest are split again with the new parameters.

params.streamHint: Larger streams are split into two or more.
params.streamError: A whole number not below the group size and not above 300
params.practiceError: A whole number not below the subgroup size

send.title: Send the timetable task?
send.description: The scheduler receives the list of streams, groups and subgroups with the number of classes and room requirements.

offering.rebuildDescription: Manual changes to groups and teachers in this section will be lost.

unit.noSiblings: There are no other units at this level to move students to.

windows.title: Registration windows
windows.hint: Outside a window students cannot change their study plan (R-01). Changes are visible to students at once.
windows.orderError: The window ends before it starts

credits.title: Credits per study plan
credits.hint: Range for bachelor's students (R-03). Exceeding it requires the registrar's permission.
credits.maxError: A whole number not below the minimum and not above 40

slots.title: Class periods
slots.hint: Periods follow in order and do not overlap. Times change in the scheduler's grid at once.

weights.title: Soft constraint weights
weights.hint: The higher the weight, the harder the solver avoids the violation. A disabled constraint is ignored (§5.3).

code.S-08: Two classes of one course on a day

weeks.title: Semester weeks
weeks.biweekly: Two-week cycle: weeks alternate odd and even.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.subtitle: Rooms, how busy they are, and times when rooms or teachers cannot be used.
rooms.capacityHint: If seats drop below the students in a class, the grid shows violation H-04.
rooms.slotsHint: Nothing ticked means the whole day.

load.title: Room usage
load.caption: Room usage by day of the week: periods taken out of the day

unavailability.title: Room unavailability
unavailability.hint: Repairs, events. The solver does not place classes there and “Find a room” does not offer it (H-06).

teachers.title: Teacher availability
teachers.hint: Hard unavailability is constraint H-06. A preference is penalty S-04 the solver tries to respect.
